january_3_lapse_claim.description: A November 5 media article attributes the view that the pending bill could lapse when the new Congress is seated on January 3, 2027, to a named industry lawyer. The Senate vote record and motion to reconsider do not themselves establish that conclusion.

macro_event.source_interpretation: Reuters reported a technology-led risk-off session as investors repriced AI/data-center buildout risk after Democratic midterm wins; higher financing costs and valuation concerns were also discussed.
macro_event.causal_limit: This is broad-market context. It does not prove that the equity selloff caused XRP's move or exclude XRP-specific positioning and flows.
macro_event.source_timing_note: Closing figures are supported by post-close publication vintages. The Reuters 10:54Z publication is retained for pre-open context and is not treated as available for the November 5 closing figures.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The broad technology/AI infrastructure selloff contributed to cross-asset risk reduction that included XRP.
support: Reuters reports Nasdaq -5.52%, S&P 500 -4.36%, Dow -3.44%, and semiconductor index approximately -12% on November 5.
counterevidence: No synchronized XRP-versus-equity intraday regression or event study is present in this artifact.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Three consecutive days of zero net XRP spot ETF flows reduced marginal demand available to absorb selling.
support: TokenPost reports no net XRP ETF flows through November 5, while cumulative net inflows remain approximately $1.81B.
counterevidence: Zero net flow is not an outflow; existing ETF holdings remain; flow data is secondary and does not establish exact spot execution timing.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Falling OKX OI alongside a high long-account ratio may leave remaining long accounts vulnerable to further forced selling if price declines.
support: CryptoTicker reports OKX OI down 8.9% while the long/short account ratio reached 4.12 at midnight.
counterevidence: Account counts are not notional exposure; this is one venue; OI measured in USD can decline partly because the underlying price declines.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: An XRP-specific issuer, protocol or regulatory event was the dominant immediate cause.
counterevidence: The reviewed same-day article reports no comparable Ripple or XRPL event; no primary-source XRP-specific trigger was established in this run.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Apparent spot-price disagreement reflects different providers and observation times rather than contradictory simultaneous prices.
support: CryptoTicker's CoinGecko observation is around 05:50Z; the later Kraken response has no provider timestamp and is lower.
